name: Ginger
text: An old ginger root. Rat specters in the box office carry it off.

name: Sugar
text: A small packet of sugar; the paper has gone yellow.

name: Folded note
text: Folded in four; frayed at the edges. Someone kept it very carefully.

name: Mung beans
text: A twist of dried mung beans; some have sprouted in the dark.

name: Knife
text: An old kitchen knife with a cracked wooden handle. The one thing you woke up holding.

name: Scalpel
text: Doctor Bao's scalpel. The blade is clean; the case is not.

name: Slingshot
text: A child's slingshot cut from a guava branch.

name: Old coat
text: A long coat from the cloakroom; the pockets still hold someone's ticket stubs.

name: Wooden hairpin
text: A plain wooden hairpin. Whoever wears it walks a little lighter.
